Black Digitron

Type
Misc
ID
thedigimod:black_digitron

Usage

Interact with a Digimon that has a dark counterpart while holding this item to trigger slide evolution into that dark form.

Obtaining

Not crafted in the current version of the mod. Drops 1-3 units, guaranteed, from any of these wild dark-counterpart Digimon when killed: Agumon (Black), AtlurKabuterimon (Blue), Gabumon (Black), BlackGrowmon, BlackMegaloGrowmon, WereGarurumon (Black), DarkLizardmon, Dark Tyrannomon, Devidramon, Garurumon (Black), GigaDramon, Greymon (Blue), MetalGreymon (Virus), and Saberdramon.
